ModMetaData.name: 空城计 (The Empty Fort Strategy)
ModMetaData.author: PooiWoop
ModMetaData.description:
「虚则实之，实则虚之。」—— 只需砌好纪念碑的外墙，内部空空如也也算「完工」。
研究「空城计」科技后，选中任意纪念碑即可切换至空城计模式，蓝图自动精简为只保留外墙。但空城瞒不过天：保护期内每天有概率被看穿，一旦露馅将任务失败、关系恶化。
【核心机制】 · 空城计模式：一键切换，外墙完工即算建成 · 败露判定：保护期内每日概率发现（默认 1%，可调 0%~100%） · 关系惩罚即刻生效（默认 25 点，可调 1~100） · 4 小时后触发委托派系惩罚袭击，每 1 小时倒计时提醒
【顶罪仪式】 败露后可以举行顶罪仪式，玩家手动选择一个正式员工或者实习生放逐： · 纪念碑 Gizmo：选中被看穿的纪念碑，直接点击「顶罪仪式」 4 小时内举行可阻止袭击，24 小时内可撤销部分关系惩罚（默认 70%，可调）
【宣传仪式】 完工纪念碑可以举行宣传仪式刷新新的纪念碑任务： · 纪念碑 Gizmo：点击「宣传仪式」按钮（默认冷却 5 天） · 仪式达到良好以上质量时便能刷新新的任务
【设置选项】 · 研究点数 0~1000（默认 200） · 每日发现概率 0%~100%（默认 1%） · 关系惩罚 1~100（默认 25） · 顶罪撤销比例 0%~100%（默认 70%） · 纪念碑任务出现概率加成（开关 + 倍率 1x~50x，默认关闭） · 宣传仪式刷新概率 0%~100%（默认 100%）
依赖：Harmony（必需）、Royalty（必需）、Ideology（可选）
欢迎任何形式的贡献与反馈：https://github.com/pooi-woop/PooiKongChengJi
--- ENGLISH
"Appearance of emptiness, substance in concealment." — Just build the outer wall of a monument and the empty interior still counts as "complete."
After researching the "Empty City Strategy" technology, select any monument to switch it into Empty City mode; the blueprint is automatically simplified to the outer wall only. But nothing deceives fate for long: during the protection period there is a daily chance you will be discovered. Once exposed, the quest fails and relations sour.
[CORE MECHANICS] · Empty City mode: one-click switch, finishing the outer wall counts as completion · Exposure check: daily chance of discovery during protection (default 1%, adjustable 0%~100%) · Relationship penalty applies immediately (default 25 points, adjustable 1~100) · A punitive raid from the questing faction triggers after 4 hours, with an hourly countdown warning
[SCRAPEGOAT RITUAL] After exposure, you may hold a Scapegoat Ritual to banish a chosen full-timer or intern yourself: · Monument Gizmo: select the exposed monument and click "Scapegoat Ritual" Holding it within 4 hours blocks the raid; within 24 hours you can revert part of the relationship penalty (default 70%, adjustable)
[PUBLICITY RITUAL] A completed monument can hold a Publicity Ritual to refresh a new monument quest: · Monument Gizmo: click the "Publicity Ritual" button (default cooldown 5 days) · Reaching at least "Good" ritual quality refreshes a new quest
[SETTINGS] · Research points 0~1000 (default 200) · Daily discovery chance 0%~100% (default 1%) · Relationship penalty 1~100 (default 25) · Scapegoat revert ratio 0%~100% (default 70%) · Monument quest spawn bonus (toggle + multiplier 1x~50x, default off) · Publicity ritual refresh chance 0%~100% (default 100%)
Dependencies: Harmony (required), Royalty (required), Ideology (optional)
Contributions and feedback are welcome: https://github.com/pooi-woop/PooiKongChengJi
